result.summary: The page appears visually functional overall, but there is one major text truncation issue in the 'Popular right now' section where the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is cut off, displaying as 'Tokumaru Ramer'.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is truncated to 'Tokumaru Ramer', cutting off the last letter and making it look like a spelling error.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text container width or font size to ensure the full restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is visible, or implement an ellipsis if truncation is intentional.
